title: Desk Guidance — No-Charge Replacement Cases, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** Summit Ridge reships at no charge under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, without billing coverage and without counting toward any limit (as the schedule's replacement-limit setting provides), in four cases, each tied to one original line:

| Case | Condition, counted from the original line |
|---|---|
| mask-fit exchange | a newly shipped interface or cushion, within the schedule's fit-exchange days of its ship date, limited to the schedule's number of exchanges per new interface |
| manufacturer defect | reported within the schedule's defect-replacement days of the ship date |
| carrier lost | a shipment with no delivery confirmation after the schedule's trace period in business days |
| wrong item | an item shipped in error |

An original line receives at most one no-charge replacement per reason. Opened items are otherwise never returned or exchanged.

## One replacement per reason

The limit is read from the system's shipment records of the enrollment: the no-charge replacements already naming the same original line with the same reason.

| Earlier no-charge replacements of the same original line | New replacement for reason R |
|---|---|
| none | allowed if R's case applies |
| one, for a different reason | allowed if R's case applies |
| one, for the same reason R | not allowed |

## Basis Q&A

**A cushion line was replaced once for a manufacturer defect. Can the same line be replaced for wrong item?** Yes, if it was shipped in error: the limit is one replacement per reason, and wrong item is a different reason.

**An opened headgear is unwanted but neither defective, lost, wrong nor a fit exchange. Is it exchanged?** No. Opened items are otherwise never returned or exchanged.

**Does a no-charge replacement bill the patient's coverage?** No. A no-charge reship bills neither coverage nor counts toward any limit.
